examined_findings.finding: The continuation reobserves row sha256 for selected file read, hosted stable-read argument, and final hash comparison; metadata is read only after byte verification. The three original SHA observations remain separate.

The r4 opcodes 63 through 68 bind db.execute, file helper/path, decode_data, reject, and get_json before argument observations at their original expression positions; profile and artifact INSERT bind SQL before row field and wire observations.
The adapter invokes actual store._ref/get/json/get_json rather than inlining subclass methods. Each entry independently selects its authority owner, as the document explicitly states.

The original admission and file operations are foreign calls. HIA decides hash-versus-hosted route, existing-content lookup, receipt comparison, issuance, INSERT, and metadata decoding; a mismatched publication receipt precedes issuance/INSERT.

Pending observation is consumed before callback/SQL. BaseException from observation or entry marks the session terminal; no finally stage emits a result after an effect failure. Malformed/terminal native status closes the exposed session.
The installed-image loader is called without a catch/fallback branch for a nonempty selected path. Dedicated source/image/missing-path controls are present, but this review did not execute them.

scope: Read-only source and AST review; no native, Core, SQL or product tests were executed by this reviewer.
scope_boundaries: There is no outer-call ContextVar snapshot. If foreign code changes the selector during a selected operation, a later nested public entry observes the new value and may select its retained owner. This is explicitly declared per-entry selection, not a promise of one immutable owner across the whole outer call.

keys() field-shape admission, SQLite execution/transactions, hosted immutable-file publication when unselected, codecs/hash owners, UUID, foreign attribute/item dispatch and rich-comparison leaves remain external.
Shared equality has documented recursive-resource, foreign-key/interpreter, allocation/finalizer and adversarial private-state limitations. No whole-Python-input equivalence is asserted.
No performance, matching-source cold, full-caller, crash-durability, installed-wheel or native test pass is independently established by this static review.
